outcome: Mode of delivery (vaginal, instrumental, caesarean section)
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing induction of labour in France, Belgium, and the Netherlands
finding: Increased uptake of oral misoprostol tablets (25 µg) for induction of labour was estimated to be associated with a slightly increased rate of routine vaginal deliveries, and concurrent decreases in instrumental vaginal deliveries and cesarean sections, which may result in cost savings.
